name: m5-unapplyseq
description: Allocation of a full compile of the scala corpus, with `case x :: Nil` in place of `case List(x)` at the sites that materialise `SeqFactory$UnapplySeqWrapper`, with an A/A. Expected effect is 14 to 23 MB/op of about 6300 MB/op, and earlier fork-to-fork spread was about 18 MB, hence ten forks each. Allocation is the metric; time noise on full compiles is too large to resolve this.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for the noise floor
variantDescriptions.cons: `c84dea8aa7` plus the pattern change at `11fccb08d8`, branch `avoid-unapplyseq-wrapper`
